name: lucarne-interact
description: The non-bot-like interaction plane: one human-paced presence over a lucarne session's cdpUrl. ACT verbs (open/snap/scroll/activate/back/capture/video.*) with enforced normal-distribution pacing after every verb; click/goto/eval do not exist. The OBSERVE half (lucarne-interact/recall) is a passive, read-only SCREEN sensor on the same connection.
author: Aaron Volter
